request:
I run a susu group at the market in Kumasi and I want to stop keeping the records in an exercise book. I need to start a group and add the members, each with their name and phone number. Every round, members pay in their contribution, and I record who paid, for which round, and how much in cedis. At the end of a round one member collects the pot, and the pot is everything that was paid in for that round, nothing more and nothing less. Each round has only one collector, and a member can collect only once, so if someone has already collected, they cannot collect again. Once a round has been collected, nobody can pay more into that round, and a round where nobody has paid anything cannot be collected. Contributions must be more than zero. For any member I want a statement showing how much they have paid in altogether and how much they have received. I also want to see the list of members and the collections made so far.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can people pay different amounts, and can someone pay a little at a time or only pay once per round?
A: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
Q: Who decides which member collects at the end of a round: do you pick the person each time, or should it follow a fixed order set at the start?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: Will you be running more than one susu group in this system, and is it only you using it, or will other people also need to log in and record payments?
A: No preference: you decide.

Where the client has no preference or did not answer, choose the simplest option and add nothing they did not ask for (no logins, PINs or extra required fields).
summary:
I wrote `app.py` and a test in `tests/test_app.py` that walks through the whole flow. The test passes. I didn't start the server to try it by hand.

**Endpoints**
- `POST /groups` starts a group (`name`). `GET /groups` and `GET /groups/{id}` show groups.
- `POST /groups/{id}/members` adds a member (`name`, `phone`). `GET /groups/{id}/members` lists them.
- `POST /groups/{id}/contributions` records a payment (`member_id`, `round`, `amount` in cedis). The amount must be more than zero. If the round has already been collected, it is refused with a 409.
- `POST /groups/{id}/rounds/{round}/collect` records who collects (`member_id`). The pot is the total paid into that round. It is refused with a 409 if the round has already been collected, if that member has already collected, or if nobody has paid into the round.
- `GET /groups/{id}/collections` lists the collections made so far.
- `GET /groups/{id}/members/{member_id}/statement` shows the member's total paid in and total received.

Because you left it to me, you choose who collects each round. There is no fixed order and no logins. I did include groups, so you can run more than one.

The data is kept in a SQLite file called `susu.db` in the project folder.
